title: Europe baffled by France's sudden leniency toward Russian oligarch Usmanov
subhead: To the surprise of its European partners, Paris has requested that billionaire Alisher Usmanov, known for his close ties to Vladimir Putin, be taken off the list of sanctioned Russian individuals.

title: Hashim Thaçi, former Kosovo president, sentenced to 25 years for war crimes
subhead: Former Kosovo president Hashim Thaçi was found guilty of war crimes and jailed for 25 years by a court in The Hague.

title: Restaurant bankruptcies surge across France as costs climb and customers spend less
subhead: Over 4,900 restaurant businesses have filed for insolvency since the start of the year, a 7% increase compared to the same period in 2025. An exceptionally hot summer failed to reverse the downward trend for the industry.

title: Catherine Ringer, legendary French artist and singer of rock duo Les Rita Mitsouko, has died
subhead: Author, composer and performer over 40 years of artistic commitment, Catherine Ringer was an independent artist. She died of an aggressive cancer on September 14.

title: 'With the Le Pens, family always comes first': Marine Le Pen launches campaign surrounded by relatives and loyalists
